summary: A campaign's route was set or taken away, so an operation, one channel of an operation, or the campaign's default, goes to the plugin it names or back to the routes above it.

key.description: Which route the line is about, in one of three forms: `default` for the campaign's default route; an operation's id, such as `message.send`, for that operation's own route; or `<operation>/<channel>`, such as `message.send/linkedin`, for the route of that operation's calls on one channel. A line keyed `<operation>/<channel>` is about that channel's route only and says nothing of the operation's own route, which is keyed by the operation alone; two routes are never one key. The separator is a slash, and the first one: an operation's id never holds a slash, nor does a channel a route may name.

old.description: The route the campaign had for the key before, or null where it had none.

binding.description: The binding the route carried, or null. Its shape is the plugin's own; it names an account and never a credential.

new.description: The route the campaign has for the key now, or null where it was taken away.

binding.description: The binding the route carries, or null. Its shape is the plugin's own; it names an account and never a credential.

anyOf.description: A route set: there may have been one before.
A route taken away: there was one, and there is none now.
